about: Terminal captures of the V4 video. Each step is typed and then run for real by capture/play.py on the machine named in 'where' (mac, vm = aip-kata-01, endpoint = aip-endpoint-01). 76x17 terminal = the channel's 36 px theme. 'scene' ties the capture to the script.

c04a-vms.scene: 04 · what was created: name prefix, labels, machine type, nested virtualization, no GPU, no service account

c04b-host.scene: 04 · 4 vCPUs; the VM itself can run a guest VM

steps.cmd: kubectl describe pod rt-kata | grep -i 'runtime class'

c05a-versions.scene: 05 · versions; a RuntimeClass selects the runtime; this pod uses Kata

steps.cmd: kubectl exec inspect -- pip list | grep -E 'anthropic|pytest'

c05b-image.scene: 05 · dependencies and checkout are already in the agent's image

c06a-policy.scene: 06 · the network rule: egress only to the gateway pod, port 8080

steps.cmd: kubectl -n lab-gateway describe deploy gateway | grep -A4 Mounts

c06b-gateway.scene: 06 · the gateway holds the key (read-only mount) and its budget state

steps.cmd: kubectl get pod inspect -o yaml | grep -E '^  (active|runtime|automount)'

c06c-identity.scene: 06 · the agent's own pod: non-root, no token mounted, no capabilities, 15-minute deadline

c06d-budget.scene: 06 · the gateway's offline budget and format test, run live against a fake upstream (11 checks, about 15 s): estimated reservation written before the call, refusals, halt when a response exceeds its reservation, long-prompt price tier

c07a-failing.scene: 07 · the frozen commit fails 3 tests before the agent touches it

c07b-attempt.scene: 07 · what one recorded attempt ran (collection data)

c08a-validate.scene: 08 · the validator, live: controls first (untouched checkout, maintainer's fix, four cheats), then one collected patch; about 2.5 min, time-lapse in the edit

c11a-open.scene: 11 · positive control, live: no policy, every target answers

c11b-restricted.scene: 11 · same probes with the policy, live (15 s wait after apply for the controller: cut in the edit)

c11d-gwlog.scene: 11 · the gateway's own log of the collection: what it refused and why, what it forwarded

c11e-endpoint.scene: 11 · the endpoint's own log: 20 control hits, none restricted, none through the gateway

c11f-https-pinned.scene: 11 · HTTPS to a public site without depending on DNS: address pinned, certificate still checked. No policy: both ways answer. With the policy: by name fails at the lookup, pinned is refused at the connection (15 s wait after apply: cut in the edit). Last command: the 10x collection, both runtimes

c12a-rbac.scene: 12 · the two identities, live: real API answers

c13a-kernel.scene: 13 · host kernel, kernel seen by the default-runtime pod, kernel seen by the Kata pod

c13b-sandbox.scene: 13/16 · each pod's sandbox on the host: runtime handler, host processes and their Pss; the runc pod's sleep is a host process, the Kata pod's (sleep 42002) is not. These are two idle `sleep` pods looked at live; the 20-start measurement of section 5 used a Python process and waited 15 s, so its totals (24.8 and 351.4 MiB) are different numbers and are the ones the narration uses

c14-final.scene: 14 · final configuration: RBAC lab gone; from the agent's own image, every target refused, the model call works

c15-perf.scene: 15/16 · start time and memory, 20 starts per runtime (collection data)

c16-bench-live.scene: 16 · the benchmark's own workload looked at live (Python process, 1 CPU, 512Mi, idle): one pod per runtime, host processes and Pss. This is the capture to pair with the memory numbers of the narration; c13b shows `sleep` pods and is only for the kernel/process point. The narration's medians come from the 20 starts (c15)

c20-cleanup.scene: result · cleanup, recorded once at 2026-11-11T13:53Z: only this experiment's two VMs selected and deleted (use up to the two 'deleted' lines; gcloud warnings about an empty filter follow)

c20b-nothing-left.scene: result · after the deletion: the same listing as scene 04 now finds nothing
